One clear path

How it works

Every proposal follows the same predictable journey from policy to decision.

01

Admin writes a policy

The wallet that deploys the contract sets the active policy in plain language and can publish new versions later. Everyone else is read-only.

Active · v…
Policy stored on chain
Owner-only updates
02

Anyone submits a proposal

Paste the proposal text on the Check Proposal page. The contract requires at least 24 characters, so noise never reaches the validators.

Proposal text
min 24 characters
Rejected if empty
03

GenLayer validators review it

Each validator asks an LLM to compare the proposal against the numbered policy rules. Consensus is reached only when the verdict and cited rule number match.

strict_eq consensus
Verdict + rule number
Deterministic reasoning
04

Decision goes on chain

Every check is appended to the Decision Log with COMPLIANT, CONFLICT or NEEDS DAO VOTE. The contract never moves treasury funds or starts a vote.

COMPLIANT
CONFLICT
NEEDS DAO VOTE
